title: Session recording must distinguish user-initiated vs agent-initiated
body: Session count in WAI-State.json is currently incremented at closeout but the session-start hook fires for all session types including agent-initiated sessions. session_count should only increment for user-initiated (human) sessions. Agent sessions should be tracked separately or flagged. This affects: session_count accuracy, analytics, and any future per-session metrics. Hook should capture session_type (user|agent) and pass to closeout for conditional increment.
